gemm-coordinate.description: a chain of K multiply-accumulates from c_0 = 0 on one tensor-core instruction's exact semantics (FP32 accumulation), then that target's epilogue

semantics.description: the exact tensor-core instruction whose accumulator step the chain uses (verity.ml.tc.instructions)

ir_definitions: GemmCoordinate_v2{K, DOT} (verity.ml.gemm); vLLM Gemm_v1 (N per token row, Ampere mma) and Gemm_v2 (Hopper wgmma) are N of them

sources.label: verity.proofs.target (GemmCoordinate<K>); backends/AGENTS.md: the decision workload, B = 4096 K = 1536 (frozen 2026-09-22)

work_model.basis: K multiply-accumulates (an FMA is 2 ops); the bf16 epilogue conversion is not counted (views.native, the tables' N)
work_model.source: verity.ml.gemm GemmCoordinate: K/16 tensor-core steps of 16 multiply-adds
work_model.bytes_basis: reads the coordinate's weight row w[K] at the operand datatype's width (BITS, census/datatypes.json); x[K] is shared by every coordinate of its row and y is one word, so neither is counted per coordinate (the batch-1 decode reading: GEMM streams its weights)
work_model.bytes_source: bench-spine's port definitions (verity_numerical.bench.templates): gemm-coordinate x[K], w[K] -> y

attention-head.name: AttentionHead<T,D>
attention-head.description: FlashAttention forward, one query head at the last position over its KV head (FA2 on sm80-class mma, FA3 on Hopper wgmma); the key count T varies per input

verifier_evaluated.parts: the softmax: the running max, MUFU.EX2, the lane sums and rescaling, MUFU.RCP of the sum and the output cast (C-Flock's native tail on the public words)
verifier_evaluated.share: 4–11% of a head's scalar ops, all of its exp2 and reciprocal work
verifier_evaluated.ruling: red-team-flock-3 granted attention on flock-ir-frame/v3 on condition that the headline footnotes this (handoff 20260926T1115Z), and the class-pin statement (one pin per key-count class, T 1–128, 129–256, 257–512) with condition CP7 (handoff 20260926T1340Z)

sources.label: red-team-flock-3's grant of AttentionHead_v3 on flock-ir-frame/v3 (lanes/coordinator/20260926T1115Z-handoff-from-red-team-flock-3.md); backends/flock/python/verity_flock/templates/attention_head.py (the softmax is the native tail the verifier evaluates)
